definitions.terminal_essential_radius: R_term(e) = inf_{a in RP^2} lim_{h -> 0^+} ess_sup_{t in (-h, 0)} d_{RP^2}(e(t), a)
definitions.chebyshev_radius: rad(C_ess(e)) = inf_{a in RP^2} sup_{z in C_ess(e)} d(z, a)
definitions.direction_cloud_radius: R_M = inf_{a in RP^2} lim_{h -> 0^+} ess_sup_{t in (-h, 0)} sup_{zeta in K_M(t)} d_{RP^2}(zeta, a)
